author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Mouse body as a taller capsule (20x22, r10 ends, straight sides) with a scroll-wheel stroke under two short flat signal arcs (r10 and r20 chords); reads as a wireless mouse.
omissions: Reference's three signal arcs reduced to two and the outlined wheel pill to a stroke (8-unit spacing between arcs and body); body proportions limited to 20x22 by the arc budget.
